correctness.rationale: Let G have maximum degree at most two, no triangles or four-cycles and at least one edge; on H=K₂□G use real edge coefficients and independent fair vertex signs. The all-graph moment formula is E F⁴=3S²−2∑a_e⁴+24∑_{base edges uv}r_ur_vp_eq_e because all four-cycles are vertical squares. The exact nonnegative deficit decomposition (4) uses the base-graph positive-part energy lemma 2∑_{uv}[3(z_u+z_v)/2−Z]_+² ≤ ∑z_v². Its active edges cannot be disjoint and, by degree≤2/triangle-free, either one edge is active or two adjacent are; the two-edge case has a strictly positive quadratic gap. Equality forces exactly two adjacent equal nonzero rung masses and one matching square with four equal magnitudes and positive sign product. An independent 4-sign full enumeration gives the stated fourth moment 912 for an illustrative coefficient vector, and sign/mass restrictions were checked. Finite tests are not the proof for all admissible G.

The published edge-disjoint-four-cycle theorem explicitly excludes their shared rung edges, and the older Q₃ cube proof treats only one finite graph via a 12-edge copositivity certificate.
